mode: Behavioral scenarios; expected outcomes are rubrics, not executed MCP results

evals.prompt: All configuration validators pass. Is the account ready?
evals.expected_output: The skill reports only structural/deterministic readiness achieved, runs the relevant simulation matrix and does not claim provider/customer-path readiness without provider evidence.
The skill runs edge cases such as correction, refusal, unknown fact, handoff, opt-out and backend actions rather than generalizing from one happy path.

evals.prompt: WhatsApp delivered the message but the stage did not change.
evals.expected_output: The skill records delivery pass and CRM-action fail separately and routes the latter to qualification/AI action diagnosis.

evals.prompt: A real production customer can be used for destructive acceptance tests without asking.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses isolated/safe test data by default and requires explicit authorization for consequential representative production actions.

evals.prompt: A previously blocked provider check becomes healthy after repair.
evals.expected_output: The skill reruns the specific provider scenario and relevant regression subset before upgrading the readiness verdict.
